summary: IES Holdings filed an 8-K reporting completion, effective October 5, 2026, of its previously announced acquisition of approximately 91.21% of DBM Global, Inc. common stock from INNOVATE Corp. under an August 7, 2026 Transaction Agreement, followed by a short-form Section 253 merger of IES Merger Sub into DBM, making DBM a wholly owned indirect subsidiary. Consideration comprised Stock Consideration plus Seller Cash Consideration. Simultaneously, IES amended its Wells Fargo-led credit agreement, raising capacity to $700 million ($200 million term loan, $500 million revolver) and adding acquired subsidiaries as guarantors. Watch for purchase-price mix, minority rollover and goodwill disclosures.
